answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded proof-of-stake registry whose genesis atlas maps every participant to a unique stake lineage, preventing cheap key-spraying sybils. Cross-validating that lineage against a cedar-anchored reputation ledger and a reef of quorum-signed attestations forces colluders to acquire distinct collateral per pseudonym. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
